claim: Patchline ships a difference-in-differences analysis with parallel-trends diagnostics and event-study plots. The worker loads a frozen, content-addressed spec and checks every item is scored and references concrete backing evidence; the gate then re-runs the worker, confirms every item is scored and evidenced, and rejects an unsupported item with empty evidence, so the parallel-trends claim is reproducible on real Patchline self-data via `make difference-in-differences-gate`.
